A1.justification: Local reading tools repeatedly stalled without returning contents, including when opening the PDF skill. Neither PDF nor its appendices could be inspected, so material completeness and comparability remain unresolved. This is an access limitation, not evidence of missing document content.

before.justification: v3.pdf could not be inspected to establish whether it reports original empirical results.

after.justification: v4.pdf could not be inspected to establish whether it reports original empirical results.

M1.justification: The method descriptions were inaccessible; changes to algorithms, models, or procedures could not be assessed.

E1.justification: The training and evaluation content was inaccessible; dataset and task coverage could not be compared.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons were inaccessible; baseline participation could not be verified in either version.

E3.justification: Experimental settings were inaccessible; protocol changes could not be distinguished from newly disclosed details.

E4.justification: Neither main-text nor appendix analyses could be inspected for changes to ablations, robustness tests, or case studies.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and statistical reporting could not be inspected or compared.

E6.justification: Results, tables, and figures were inaccessible; numerical values and qualitative findings could not be matched across versions.

T1.justification: Mathematical content and appendices could not be inspected for changes to definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were inaccessible; changes to core claims could not be assessed.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations could not be inspected to determine whether substantive explanations or qualifications changed.

D1.justification: Technical details and access disclosures were inaccessible; reproducibility information could not be compared.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and references could not be inspected for citation or research-positioning changes.

P1.justification: Document text was inaccessible; rewriting, terminology changes, and structural reorganization could not be assessed.

P2.justification: No rendered pages were obtained; changes to figures, tables, captions, and layout could not be assessed.

improvement.justification: Neither PDF, including its appendices, could be read because local tools remained unresponsive. No inspected before-and-after evidence supports a reliable judgment about overall quality.
